title: fix(sandbox): drop Hermes Agent from the sandbox templates
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Removed the unused Hermes Agent installation from the pollinations and pollinations-large sandbox templates, cutting roughly 2.5 GB from each image: 2.4 GB in ~/.hermes and 0.1 GB for its Python 3.14 installation. The preinstalled harnesses are now Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and OpenClaw. The first-login harness loop no longer attempts Hermes, avoiding a failure log, and the sandbox docs reflect the new list. `polli harness hermes on` still works after Hermes is installed separately. Smaller images can build faster, but free disk in a new sandbox remains governed by `--min-free-disk-mb` (50 GiB on large).
